title: One signal, many accounts: firm account limits, the owner's own per-account limits, and placeholder firms (engine/copy_accounts.py); firms filled 2026-11-14 (team A4)
how_to_read: Same value format as research/props/firm_rules.json: {"v": value, "verified": bool, "src": [...], "date": "yyyy-mm-dd", "n": note}. v null = unknown (never guessed); v "none" = the rule does not exist. The plan rules of the firms the bot can trade (MFFU Builder 25K / 50K and the rest) stay in firm_rules.json (built by tools/build_firm_rules.py); this file adds (1) how many accounts a person may hold at each firm, (2) PLACEHOLDER firms and plans whose values are still to be filled from the firm research (research/writeups/millionaire-plan-2026-11-13.md, team M1), and (3) the documentation of every field. A placeholder plan with dd_amount null NEVER trades: the rule engine assumes no room until the max loss is known.

plan (eval / funded block).target: $ profit target of the eval (passed when reached and the min days / best-day rule are met)
plan (eval / funded block).dd_type: max-loss floor type: eod (follows the best CLOSING balance), intraday (follows the best balance incl. open profit; strictest), static (never moves)
plan (eval / funded block).dd_amount: $ max loss (distance from the high-water mark to the floor); null = the account never trades
plan (eval / funded block).lock: $ above start where the trailing floor stops moving (e.g. 100 = the floor locks at start + $100); null = never locks (strictest reading)
plan (eval / funded block).dll: $ daily loss limit; "none" = no daily limit
plan (eval / funded block).dll_type: soft (trading pauses for the rest of the day) | hard (the account fails)
plan (eval / funded block).max_micros: most micros (MNQ) open at once; minis count 10 micros
plan (eval / funded block).max_minis: most minis open at once (used when max_micros is unknown)
plan (eval / funded block).consistency: eval best-day rule as a share of the target (0.4 = no day above 40% of the target); "none" = no rule
plan (eval / funded block).news: {"flat_min_before": n, "flat_min_after": n} around Tier-1 releases, or "none"
plan (eval / funded block).max_active: funded block only: how many funded accounts of THIS plan one person may hold (enforced by the fleet)
plan (eval / funded block).max_micros_by_profit: [[profit_from, micros], ...]: the firm's contract scaling (LucidFlex funded, Bulenox Option 2): the most micros at the account's profit at the last close (balance - start); absent = the flat max_micros (engine/firms.max_micros_at)

plan (payout block).buffer: $ profit above start before any payout
plan (payout block).consistency: funded best day as a share of the payout cycle's profit (not a breach: trade more days)
plan (payout block).max_payouts: payouts before the account moves on (live / closed)
plan (payout block).max_after_first: $ biggest payout from the second payout on (LucidPro 50K $2,500); absent = max for every payout
plan (payout block).cycle_min: $ profit the payout cycle must make before a request (LucidPro / FundedNext $500); absent = not checked
plan (payout block).share: a request <= this share of the cycle's profit (LucidFlex 0.5); "none" = no share cap
plan (payout block).win_days: profitable days a payout cycle needs (LucidFlex 5); "none" = no count
plan (payout block).win_day_min: $ a day must make to count as profitable for win_days (LucidFlex 50K $150)

firm.bots: allowed | own | semi_only | prohibited | api_only (a fully automated bot on NinjaTrader needs allowed / own)
firm.copy_trading: allowed | own_accounts | prohibited (copying between your OWN accounts at this firm)
firm.hedging: banned_all_accounts = never long and short on one underlying across your accounts (the bot's rule for every firm)
firm.flat_by: HH:MM ET the firm flattens (no new entry 5 minutes before)
firm.ninjatrader: true = the firm offers NinjaTrader for this bot
firm.accounts.max_funded_total: funded accounts one person may hold at this firm across all its plans (enforced when known; the smaller reading when sources conflict)
firm.accounts.max_eval_active: evals one person may run at once (information only today)
firm.inactivity_days: calendar days without a trade after which the firm deletes / breaches the account (Lucid, FundedNext 30): the account's status warns 7 days before
firm.hold: a reason string = the bot takes NO new entry at this firm (engine/firms.check blocks) until the owner clears it per account with rules {"hold": "none"} (where the firm's own text needs a written yes first: FundedNext, Bulenox)
firm.payout_guard: OFF by default. true (per account: rules {"payout_guard": true}) = a funded copy's winner is capped so the day stays inside the payout best-day rule (Lucid 40% of the cycle): the day may pay at most max(share x the cycle's goal, share/(1-share) x the cycle's earlier profit); soft, never below 1 micro (a big day only delays a payout)

own (per account in data/fleet.json, the.day_stop_usd: own stop for the day: no new copy on this account once today's loss (closed + open) reaches it; the size also fits it
own (per account in data/fleet.json, the.week_stop_usd: own stop for the week (Monday to Friday)
own (per account in data/fleet.json, the.max_micros: own contract cap (never above the firm's)
own (per account in data/fleet.json, the.max_risk_usd: own most $ at risk a trade (a full stop-out incl. 2 ticks of slippage and costs)

per account switches (data/fleet.json).killed: this account's kill switch: flattened at the next poll, no new entry (--kill <id>, --unkill <id>)
per account switches (data/fleet.json).stop_day: yyyy-mm-dd: no new entry on this account that session (--stop-today <id>); it resumes by itself the next session
per account switches (data/fleet.json).armed / armed_for: a real (non-Sim) account trades only when the owner typed I ACCEPT LIVE RISK for THAT account Name (--arm <id>), the phrase was typed at the bot's start and NINJATRADER_LIVE=1
per account switches (data/fleet.json).held_funded (top level): {plan id: n} funded accounts of a plan the owner already holds OUTSIDE the fleet (the leads' own accounts), counted against the firm's limit
